commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+6' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.

90+4' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Yangel Herrera will be replaced by Arnau Martinez (Girona).
89' Michel decides to make a substitution. Ivan Martin will be replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
88' Here's the latest number of offsides – 2:3.
86' Las Palmas are seeing far more of the ball now.
81' Substitution. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) has come on for Javier Munoz.
81' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Girona for a penalty. Play continues.
80' Here's the change. Savio leaves the pitch and Pablo Torre (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
78' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Maximo Perrone is replaced by Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas).
75' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:3.
72' The attendance is 18734.
70' Substitution. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) on for Artem Dovbyk.
70' It appears to be a head injury for Yan Couto so no chances are being taken and he’s replaced by Portu (Girona).
69' Yan Couto (Girona) receives a yellow card for infringement.
68' Yan Couto (Girona) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
66' Corner kicks – 4:2.
63' The substitution has been made. Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) has replaced Alex Suarez.
63' Here is a change. Daley Sinkgraven is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas).
63' Substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) replaces Sandro Ramirez.
62' Las Palmas hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
59' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:6.
57' 0 - 2 Goal! Alvaro Valles gets a hand on the penalty from Artem Dovbyk (Girona), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
56' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Girona!
55' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Girona, he's going to review using VAR.
55' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
54' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Girona.
52' The Girona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

49' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Paulo Gazzaniga was alert and the score remains the same.
47' The resulting corner from Aleix Garcia (Girona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Yellow card! It's like Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez agrees and books him.
45+3' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
43' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle. Yan Couto (Girona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
42' The percentage of ball possession is – 54:46.
39' This is a yellow card! Yangel Herrera (Girona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
39' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Yangel Herrera (Girona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Artem Dovbyk (Girona) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
33' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off the line to clear the ball away.
31' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
29' Las Palmas are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! David Lopez (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
26' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Alvaro Valles leaps out to thwart his attempt.

25' A player from Las Palmas commits a rough challenge. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Girona!
25' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
23' Las Palmas string together a series of short passes.
21' Aleix Garcia (Girona) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
20' One of the Girona players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
18' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
17' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is penalised for holding. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a set piece.
16' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

15' Marvin (Las Palmas) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Las Palmas.
14' The foul by Marvin (Las Palmas) was seen by Jorge Figueroa Vazquez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
12' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
10' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the left side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Paulo Gazzaniga who easily stops the effort.
8' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
8' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Las Palmas!
7' Celebrations by Las Palmas are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
6' David Lopez (Girona) makes a rough challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Las Palmas.
5' Daley Blind (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
4' The free kick from long range, taken by Las Palmas, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
3' The resulting corner from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes to nothing.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Girona will have the kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez will referee today's match.
